attributes.residual: THE DISCRIMINATOR'S UNSTATED PRECONDITION, which is what this record exists to write down. The screen's DATUM-SWAP test is 'the same register, at the same position, under the same mnemonic, receives a DIFFERENT datum'. That is decisive only if the two streams AGREE on register colouring. Where they do not - and they do not, in every one of these twelve - a CONSISTENT EXCHANGE of two registers presents to a positional register test as an exchange of their two datums, because the test reads the register NAME as an identity rather than as an allocator choice. Measured examples: do_player_select's r21/r22 exchange holds at all 20 use sites listed by `fnasm --ours | grep -E 'r21|r22'`; move_logic00's is an FPR exchange (target f30=pi/f25=2pi, ours f29=pi/f30=2pi) and the arithmetic at 0x220-0x2d4 is instruction-for-instruction identical under it. THE MECHANICAL TEST (CV_scratch/cv_verify_rows.py, ~40 lines over fndiff.parse, no build): for the two datums a mirrored pair names, collect every referencing instruction in both streams; key datums by VALUE (fndiff.datum_key) not by NAME, so a pool alias is not a different datum; DROP the ADDR16_HA half, because the scratch register carrying a high half is not where the datum lands; then require the (datum, mnemonic) profiles to match and the target-to-ours map of destination registers to be a bijection. Without the value keying and the @ha drop the same script scores only 7 of 12 - both refinements are load-bearing, and their absence is exactly the shape of the screen's own blind spot.

hypothesis.statement: The screen's TWO-SIDED CALIBRATION is measuring agreement with another screen rather than with ground truth, and its positive control is refuted by this record. Its docstring's positive control is es_named_reloc_census's 8 TRANSPOSED, of which 6 became DEFECT; SIX OF THOSE EIGHT (generate_enemy, ReadControls, fn_800C7558, write_shop_menu, InitNameAudio, do_player_select) are in the twelve refuted here, i.e. the whole positive half of the calibration. es_named_reloc_census's TRANSPOSED verdict is literally 'datum multiset VALUE-EQUAL, labels ARE a permutation' - which is the DEFINITION of a consistent register renaming over an equal datum set, so the control set was selected FOR the artifact. The docstring's separate claim that move_logic00 is 'an independent positive control this screen was not fitted to' is refuted the same way: it is an FPR renaming. The tool's calibration block should be rewritten with a ground-truth column.
